task.title: Create and configure a Cloud Administrator group
task.shortdesc: An Organization Administrator of a Red Hat account creates a group with the Cloud Administrator role and adds members to the group. The members of this group can manage cloud and Red Hat integrations on the Hybrid Cloud Console.

ul.li: You are logged in to the Hybrid Cloud Console as a user who has Organization Administrator permission. You cannot log in to the Hybrid Cloud Console with your email address unless your email address is the same as your Red Hat login. For more information, see .
If you are not an Organization Administrator, you must be a member of a group that has the User Access administrator role assigned to it.

step.cmd: Under Identity & Access Management, click User Access > Groups.
Enter a group name, for example, Cloud Administrators, and a description, and then click Next.
Find Cloud Administrator in the list of roles, select the checkbox next to it, and then click Next.

substep.cmd: Search for individual users or filter by username, email, or status.
Select the checkbox for the users you want to add to the group, then click Next.

step.cmd: Review the details and click Submit to finish creating the group.

ul.li: Verify that your new group is listed on the Groups page.
